care-channels.title: Customer care channels
care-channels.hint: Connect Zalo OA, Telegram... to receive order notifications and chat with customers.

fields.name: Channel name
fields.notifyOrdersHint: Send a message to this channel whenever a new order is placed (sales care).
fields.receiveMessagesHint: Receive messages customers send to this channel and let staff reply (general care).
fields.telegramSectionHint: Create a bot with @BotFather, add it to the notification group, then fill in the fields below.
fields.chatIdHint: The group/chat ID that receives notifications (group IDs usually start with -100).
fields.zaloSectionHint: Copy these values from the Official Account's Zalo Developer Console.
fields.refreshTokenHint: Tokens rotate automatically when the system refreshes them — only paste new ones obtained from Zalo.
fields.notifyUserIdsHint: Comma-separated user IDs of staff receiving notifications — each user must have messaged the OA at least once.
fields.secretKeepHint: When editing, leave blank to keep the stored value.

webhook.title: Inbound message webhook
webhook.telegramHint: Click the button to register the webhook with Telegram (requires a public HTTPS backend via MEDUSA_BACKEND_URL).
webhook.zaloHint: Copy this URL and paste it into the Webhook section of the Zalo Developer Console.

messages.deleteConfirmDesc: Channel "{{name}}" will be removed and stop sending/receiving messages.
messages.testSent: Test message sent — check your channel

reply.title: Conversation with {{user}}
reply.empty: No messages in this conversation yet

events.title: Events
events.hint: Events shown on the website — visitors can register to reserve seats.

fields.title: Title
fields.thumbnailHint: Shown on event cards in listing pages and at the top of the detail page.
fields.capacityHint: When all seats are taken, the website stops accepting new registrations automatically.
fields.seoSectionHint: Optional — leave blank to fall back to the event title and description.
fields.seoDescriptionPlaceholder: defaults to an auto-generated excerpt from the content
fields.seoKeywordsPlaceholder: comma-separated, e.g. lotus tea, tea workshop

messages.deleteConfirmDesc: Are you sure you want to delete "{{title}}"? Its registrations will be kept.

sections.handlingHint: Contact the registrant, note down the outcome and update the registration status.

fields.name: Full name
fields.staffNotePlaceholder: e.g. Called at 10am to confirm, 2 attendees...

messages.deleteConfirmDesc: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"'s registration?

campaign-posts.title: Campaign Posts
campaign-posts.scheduleHint: Set publish and unpublish times to publish automatically

fields.title: Title
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: A brief summary of the post
fields.descriptionHint: Shown on post listings and used as the default SEO description when the SEO section below is left empty.
fields.thumbnailHint: Shown on post cards in listing pages — falls back to the first image in the content when empty.
fields.sourceHint: Credit the original source when this post is adapted from elsewhere, e.g. "Via VnExpress".
fields.seoSectionHint: Optional — leave blank to fall back to the post title and short description.
fields.seoDescriptionPlaceholder: defaults to the short description above
fields.seoKeywordsPlaceholder: comma-separated, e.g. lotus tea, vietnamese tea

messages.duplicated: Post duplicated successfully — the copy is inactive
messages.deleteConfirmDesc: Are you sure you want to delete "{{title}}"?

productDuplicate.title: Duplicate product
productDuplicate.hint: Create a draft copy including variants, options, images, prices, categories and sales channels. SKU / barcode are left blank for you to fill in.

campaign-topics.title: Post Topics
campaign-topics.hint: Topics group posts — each topic gets its own listing page on the website with a banner image.

fields.name: Topic name
fields.slugCopyHint: Click the button next to the field to copy the full path (no domain) to this topic's page on the website.
fields.imageHint: Large hero image shown at the top of this topic's listing page.

messages.deleteConfirmDesc: Are you sure you want to delete topic "{{name}}"? Its posts will simply become untagged, not deleted.

cards.title: Homepage Cards
cards.hint: Cards shown on the homepage. Drag and drop to reorder — the 3 fixed cards (Promotions, Contact, Map) cannot be deleted or edited.
cards.lockedNotice: This is a fixed card — you can only reorder or hide/show it, not change its content or type.

media.title: Choose thumbnail image

media.dropHint: Drag and drop an image here or click to choose a file

messages.importEmpty: The file has no data to import

mediaLib.title: Image Library
mediaLib.hint: Manage all uploaded images: organize them into folders, upload new ones or delete unused images. Before deleting, the system always checks whether the image is in use anywhere.
mediaLib.folderDeleteConfirmDesc: Delete folder "{{name}}"? Images inside will be moved to "Uncategorized", not deleted.
mediaLib.empty: No images in this section yet.

messages.folderDeleted: Folder deleted, its images were moved to Uncategorized

delete.checking: Checking whether the image is in use anywhere...

delete.notUsed: This image is not used anywhere — safe to delete.
